scope: Read-only review of the eight integrated firmware/observer/parser/campaign/test diffs; no additional simulation
verified: Only READY 0x24 inserts the preceding fence; existing following fence, memory clobber, nonzero rd and returned-code check remain.
New macro requires DRAINN, DRAIN8, DIRECT and inherits existing Y32/packed16/autogroup constraints; old macro-off load identity is proven separately.
Every READY_WAIT edge observes independent wrapper metadata, capability, low claim, no LSU command and exact remaining per-group edge budget.
Every row pairs its accepted STARTROW endpoint command with the retired endpoint response before accepting NICE; source fence is required and asserted.
READY forbids every accepted ROW_STATUS query and every NICE LSU read; existing source/status ABI reads remain counted.
Original per-lane golden values, FIFO ownership, next-edge POP, each write response, final response before completion, OITF and held command/completion checks remain.
Parser requires exact READY markers, readiness/groups/snapshot/POP/Y counts, zero polls, bounded real wait edges, and all original STREAM/DIRECT markers.
Physical clear helper, request-window definition, clock/reset policy, core LSU/BIU control and numeric model remain unchanged.
nonblocking_notes: READY_WAIT state value is intentionally tied to measured RTL value 9; future state renumbering requires observer update.
Whole ELF hashes can differ across recompilation because a non-load FILE symbol names a random GCC temporary object; load bytes/image identity is the compatibility check.
